Game Overview

In FlappyBall, the core idea is straightforward: guide your flapping ball through a maze of obstacles in FlappyBall. With each tap, navigate tighter spaces, aiming for higher scores amidst retro graphics and an addictive soundtrack. Test your reflexes and timing in this thrilling, endless arcade challenge. Can you master the rhythm and soar past your friends?

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in FlappyBall is easy to pick up. Guide your flapping ball through a maze of obstacles in FlappyBall.
